QuestInfo.name: [Tallahart] The Great Bridge
QuestInfo.0: Luce prepares the spell needed to enter Tallahart, but will all go as planned?
QuestInfo.2: Just as Luce was about to dispel the last illusion, Gerand Darmoor's subordinate, #rVeronica#k, appeared and attacked you. She sent regenerating enemies after you, and Hawkeye stayed behind to fend them off. Will he be okay...? No time to worry, you need to chase after the Flora.
